caption: The drawing depicts a section of an interior room with beige walls and a medium-brown wooden floor. On the left side of the image is a wooden door with four vertical panels, painted in a light brown or honey color, featuring a black metal handle. To the right of the door, attached to the wall, is a rectangular wooden panel or shutter that matches the door in color and style, with visible hinges on its right edge. Further to the right is a built-in wooden storage unit with a matching honey-brown frame and containing eight stacked drawers. Each drawer is equipped with two round wooden drawer pulls. The room has a wooden baseboard and a horizontal chair rail, both in the same light brown color as the other woodwork, running along the wall. The composition is rectangular and centered, with the walls and floor converging at an angle, suggesting a perspective view of the corner of the room. There are no other objects or decorations present in the scene.
title: Built-in Drawers and Cupboards
